==Objectives==
Seek the [[druid]]s at the foot of the [[World Tree]] [[Nordrassil]] in [[Hyjal]].

==Description==
<Class>, news spread from atop the sacred Mount Hyjal. Our greatest fear, the [[Emerald Nightmare|Nightmare]], has taken root and seeps once more into our realm. Many brave souls venture to the great World Tree to offer assistance to our brethren's cause to quell the Nightmare's influence.

<Name>, I implore you to ascend Mount Hyjal and aid the [[Wardens of Nordanaar]] in their endeavors.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*1200 XP
*+100 [[reputation]] with [[Cenarion Circle]]

==Progress==
Greetings, adventurer. To ensure [[Azeroth|our world]]'s continued existence, we accept anyone willing to assist.

==Completion==
[[Moonglade]] sending support is assuring to hear, young one. The turmoil we are facing should be the concern of us all, is it not perilous to ignore it.
